lamellar_climbing_digit.reason: Toe scales are sculpted as relief. Adhesive force, exact release path and tip attachment across foot types require study.
lamellar_climbing_digit.discriminator: Repeated lamellae under the digit provide a longitudinal contact surface that can peel. The anuran draft provides a single enlarged terminal contact instead.

review.evidence: Underside rows and claw are visible. Relief is more uniform and shallow than the specimen’s curved overlapping scales.

opposed_toe_bundles.reason: The source shows grip on one branch. Two-diameter seating, actual contact and mounted handedness remain to be measured.
opposed_toe_bundles.discriminator: Two opposing toe bundles act as broad grip faces with shared movement within each bundle.

review.evidence: Five claw tips read in a three-quarter view with a 3+2 cleft. One claw in the three-toe bundle is shorter and more isolated than the specimen.

interlocking_caudal_rattle.reason: Hollow wall thickness, captive joint play and sound are inferred. The exported nested pose does not establish dynamics.
interlocking_caudal_rattle.discriminator: Loose interlocking hollow segments hang from the tail tip with exposed gaps for limited independent movement.

review.evidence: The tapering stack and nested lips read. The contour is smoother than the original and internal captive play remains unverified.

hinged_plastral_lobe.reason: Slider poses approximate the hinge. Closed rim fit and exact full live rotation are pending.
hinged_plastral_lobe.discriminator: An underside lobe rotates across a transverse plastral hinge and meets the edge of a fixed dorsal shell.

review.evidence: The transverse edge and shallow plate read. Scute boundaries remain fainter than the in-specimen underside, and isolated geometry cannot establish hinge fit.

flattened_leaf_tail.reason: The oblique photo supports the dorsal shape. A calibrated lateral thickness and seated bend check are still needed.
flattened_leaf_tail.discriminator: An asymmetric expanded tail forms a broad flattened leaf outline with irregular edge cutouts and almost no projecting axial ridge.

review.evidence: The stem, flat blade, and distal point are visible. The photo shows stronger uneven notches than the sculpt.

burrowing_forefoot.reason: The article text supports the macroscopic anatomy. Direct image comparison of the supplementary video and independently measured claw-to-palm ratios are pending. The pose control is roll at the local attachment. Coordinated shoulder and wrist kinematics are outside this mesh.
burrowing_forefoot.discriminator: A broad, outward-facing digging hand with a widened medial edge is missing. Longer claws on an existing hand do not provide the same soil-contact silhouette.

ground_braced_tail.reason: The lateral walking view supports the sagittal profile. Transverse flattening and exact contact pressure are inferred. The brace control gives static endpoints. No timing or force simulation is claimed.
ground_braced_tail.discriminator: A broad proximal tail can form a load path from a pelvic root to a long grounded segment while both hindfeet lift. A free tail chain has no stable support surface.

nail_rim_cushion_foot.reason: Nail count varies. Three seats represent the cited hindfoot condition. Reference captions and anatomy text were inspected. Nail orientation and exact transverse profile still require registered comparisons. The spread control is a sculpting variation, without validated compliance.
nail_rim_cushion_foot.discriminator: A deep continuous plantar cushion supports a broad foot under a columnar limb, with discrete nails inserted into the perimeter wall. Neither a hard hoof capsule nor discrete pads captures the shared cushion-to-wall interface.

splayed_two_toe_sole.reason: The source describes internal pads on either side of a septum. The shared exterior heel skin is modeled as one mesh. Source captions and anatomy text were inspected. A synchronized side and plantar loaded-to-lifted pair has not been calibrated. The splay control changes shape across two geometric endpoints without a tissue model.
splayed_two_toe_sole.discriminator: Two large toe-bearing lobes share a broad soft sole with a distal cleft and separate dorsal nails. Under stance the lobes can diverge while the proximal pad remains continuous.

offset_two_toe_running_foot.reason: The sole tread and small cornified papillae are omitted at fixture scale. Reference figure captions and anatomy text were inspected. Matched body loads and stride timing remain pending.
offset_two_toe_running_foot.discriminator: A large central support toe has a full longitudinal contact strip, with a shorter lateral toe making a separate off-axis contact. The toes have separate sole cushions and do not form a hard paired hoof.

leading_edge_alula_hinge.reason: The cited work describes the broader avian range of two to six feathers. Four vanes are a draft, not a counted specimen reconstruction. Exact hinge axis direction and distal profile need registered dorsal and edge-on specimen views. Operating poses are static geometry. The aerodynamic field is outside this fixture.
leading_edge_alula_hinge.discriminator: A digit-rooted feather cluster can lift ahead of the main leading edge and create a narrow gap independently of the primary feather fan. Its local pivot precedes the wrist-tip feather hinge.

compound_ventral_suction_disc.reason: Papilla density and crown relief are simplified. Released rim and pressure response are inferred.
compound_ventral_suction_disc.discriminator: The adhesive footprint includes anterior and posterior regions formed at the pectoral and pelvic bases. Their extended rim and papilla fields require different seating from the goby pelvic-only rim.

serial_caudal_finlets.reason: Both banks use eight finlets within the reported range. Depth, decreasing projected heights and hinge angles are draft estimates.
serial_caudal_finlets.discriminator: Short repeatable, independently rooted fins form dorsal and ventral rows separated by exposed skin. A common placement and angle rig must preserve the gaps and diminishing footprint.

segmented_spinelet_dorsal.reason: Articular canal and bifid spine tip are omitted. The degree of neighbor attachment and fold profile need a clearer specimen pose.
segmented_spinelet_dorsal.discriminator: Each serial module carries its own leading spine and trailing membrane. A folding row must preserve the individual spine-to-web boundary and seat each base independently.

pelvic_shield_spine_pair.reason: Shield cross-section and joint clearances are inferred. Spine thickness and tooth spacing are approximate. This is a rigid skeletal study.
pelvic_shield_spine_pair.discriminator: Long pelvic spines seat on opposite sides of a shared ventral girdle plate. Each can clear the belly when erected, with its own seat and pivot.

paired_caudal_peduncle_keels.reason: Accessory offsets and transverse rake are inferred from qualitative sources. No species-matched measured cross-section.
paired_caudal_peduncle_keels.discriminator: Thin longitudinal keels project from the lateral walls of the tail stalk. The paired bases taper into the peduncle immediately before the tail, with negligible spanwise movement at the root.

terminal_clavus.reason: Skin/ossicle distinction is represented as coarse external relief. Deflection range and hidden section remain inferred.
terminal_clavus.discriminator: A deep rear fan attaches across the blunt trunk margin and joins the ends of the dorsal and anal regions. The wide posterior seat replaces a narrow terminal peduncle root.

distal_tentacle_club.reason: Section depths and absolute dimensions are inferred. Species-matched oral and edge views and a local prey-capture pose remain open. Four rows show representative cups. Fine teeth, protective membranes and trabeculae are out of scope.
distal_tentacle_club.discriminator: A narrow strike stalk carries a flattened, expanded distal grip club with discrete sucker zones on one face.

mantle_ribbon_fin.reason: Fin-wave phase is a static geometry control. Ray-free thickness, wave amplitude, wavelength and local root curvature are inferred. Recorded phase progression and measured outline comparison remain open.
mantle_ribbon_fin.discriminator: A narrow fin ribbon has a long continuous mantle seam and a free edge that can carry a traveling bend along one side.

hinged_bivalve_valves.reason: Pose control rotates around an inferred transverse line. Hinge ligament, mantle body and finer growth sculpture are out of scope. Seam interlock and live gape under load await corresponding reference and local fixture.
hinged_bivalve_valves.discriminator: Two cupped valves face one another and rotate around a shared dorsal line, with an opposing closure rim and hinge ears.

fused_double_siphon.reason: The channels end as shallow exterior recesses. Internal organs and hydraulics are out of scope. Reference samples are from different poses or specimens. Extension and bend calibration are open.
fused_double_siphon.discriminator: A common extensible sheath encloses two externally visible apertures with distinct rim contours separated by a bridge.

retractile_lamellate_rhinophore.reason: Relative diameter and sheath wall depth are inferred. Shortening control approximates the visible withdrawn state and does not simulate soft tissues. Calibrated matched retraction views are pending.
retractile_lamellate_rhinophore.discriminator: An upright stalk has overlapping transverse lamellae and retracts into a dedicated dorsal pocket rim.

biramous_chaetal_parapodium.reason: Depth of the two fleshy branches, bristle-count simplification and fitted orientation are inferred. Internal aciculae are excluded. Same-specimen three-quarter outline and live loaded locomotor sweep remain open.
biramous_chaetal_parapodium.discriminator: One lateral fleshy mount divides into two rami ending in separated chaetal fans, with clear spaces between both contact rows.

coiling_siphoning_proboscis.reason: Paired external seam is coarse. The model preserves approximately the centerline length through authored poses. Hidden contact surfaces and natural curvature progression were not measured.
coiling_siphoning_proboscis.discriminator: The paired galeae join into one flexible conduit that stores in a compact planar coil and straightens from its facial seat.

opposed_spined_foreleg.reason: The model represents gross spine rows and an authored flexion arc. Tooth counts, hinge limits, spine clearance against a specimen and detailed distal joints remain unverified.
opposed_spined_foreleg.discriminator: A broadened spined femur and hinged spined tibia fold into an opposed clamp, carried on an elongated coxa.

fossorial_tibial_shovel.reason: Single projected macro supports margins and the tarsal offset. Thickness, exact taper and tarsal flexion are authored. The tip orientation is local and the specimen’s absolute scale is unavailable.
fossorial_tibial_shovel.discriminator: A broad toothed tibial shovel seats beside a small articulated tarsus, creating a rigid soil-contact edge proximal to the foot.

clubbed_halter_balance_organ.reason: Default rod/club dimensions and travel are inferred. The Musca macro obscures the root and does not support a measured range.
clubbed_halter_balance_organ.discriminator: A short narrow stalk with a terminal club oscillates at a small basal joint behind the flight wing.

bipectinate_sensory_antenna.reason: The authored approximate basket angle and branch count are not measured from the WT-M projection. No individual sensilla or internal segments are modeled.
bipectinate_sensory_antenna.discriminator: Paired lateral rami arise along successive flagellar segments and taper toward both ends, forming a two-sided comb on a continuous shaft.

hooked_soft_abdominal_proleg.reason: Schematic external landmarks informed a coarse flexible lobe. Crochet count, soft-tissue response and actual load-dependent grip were not measured.
hooked_soft_abdominal_proleg.discriminator: A compressible unsegmented abdominal lobe terminates in a soft pad with a curved row of fine hooks at its edge.

traveling_wave_anal_ribbon.reason: This is a local excerpt with 32 coarse visible ray bands. Direction follows increasing or decreasing phase. No observed speed, phase speed or signed force is imposed.
traveling_wave_anal_ribbon.discriminator: A long, ventral anal ribbon sends an alternating wave along a continuous root while the trunk remains comparatively stable. The repeated ray stations and a controlled phase direction define the motion.

ray_fan_with_ventral_sword.reason: Ray branching and segment sutures are simplified. Available specimen references do not calibrate 3D camber.
ray_fan_with_ventral_sword.discriminator: A rounded ray fan has a ventral bundle that extends as a narrow sword. The bundle emerges from rays shared with the ventral fan rather than forming a second foil lobe.

lobed_fin_with_distal_ray_fan.reason: The flex axis and solid skin thickness are inferred. Full-fold lobe-to-web overlap and trunk clearance require fit review.
lobed_fin_with_distal_ray_fan.discriminator: A thick fleshy proximal lobe has a movable distal transition into a fin-ray fan. The lobe, distal flex axis and terminal fan require distinct sections and articulation.

detached_pectoral_walking_rays.reason: The main web is a local proxy. Distal taste papillae and contact-scale kinematics are omitted.
detached_pectoral_walking_rays.discriminator: The lowest pectoral rays are free, separately anchored and mobile below the main fin. Their attachment and stance must coexist with the intact webbed fin above.

perforated_shell_vent_row.reason: Uniform sector thickness and two sealed-site profiles are simplified. No fitted whole shell or living tissue is modeled. No measured pore spacing and matched silhouette are available.
perforated_shell_vent_row.discriminator: A single curvature-matched shell band carries a row of through-holes with raised collars and a sequence of closed former openings.

stalked_tube_operculum.reason: The model supports independent stopper width and stalk length. No actual time-dependent retraction is implemented. The sculpt is intentionally scale-adjustable. The published reference across the stopper is about 4 mm, whereas the default modeled rim is larger. Stopping position and contact with a measured tube rim remain unverified.
stalked_tube_operculum.discriminator: A funnel-shaped stopper is carried on an elongate flexible stalk at the crown base and seats against the protective tube opening during withdrawal.

bifid_proboscis_gutter.reason: The model depicts exterior shape and grooves only. Groove depths and outstretched live pose are inferred from preserved images and descriptions. The local substrate contact path is untested.
bifid_proboscis_gutter.discriminator: A flat ribbon splits into two broad distal lobes while a continuous exposed collecting gutter leads back toward the mouth.

septate_coral_polyp_cup.reason: The model simplifies septal relief into a small number of height levels. Distinct pali and fine columella structure remain unresolved. The polyp itself and its retraction are outside the rigid cup model.
septate_coral_polyp_cup.discriminator: A rigid cup carries radial septa projecting inward from its wall and supports a retracting soft polyp by the full enclosing circumference.

sheathed_tentacle_with_tentilla.reason: Only the external sheath collar and deployed tentacle segment are modeled. Internal sheath and tissue turnover are out of scope. Filament length and lateral-branch splay are inferred and simplified. The extension control does not show the full withdrawal mechanism.
sheathed_tentacle_with_tentilla.discriminator: A main retractable filament with repeated side branches leaves an individual body-side sheath aperture.

sand_fringe_digit.reason: Exact counts, in-sand contact and mating clearance remain unmeasured.
sand_fringe_digit.discriminator: Free lateral combs on individual toes increase contact width while the toe gaps stay open.

hindfoot_excavation_spade.reason: The photograph does not supply physical scale or a loaded digging pose. Backwards substrate contact and neighboring digits are pending.
hindfoot_excavation_spade.discriminator: A hard cutting spade sits on the inner heel, leaving forward toes clear for traction.

ventral_traction_scute_row.reason: Cross-sectional thickness, root seating and friction are inferred. The photo substantiates external arrangement.
ventral_traction_scute_row.discriminator: Broad transverse belly scutes cover most of the contact width and overlap along the travel direction on an otherwise flexible body.

raised_trunk_annuli.reason: Depth and annular count per unit length are stylized. Bend is an adjustable sculpt state, and real axial kinematics remain open.
raised_trunk_annuli.discriminator: Deep transverse skin furrows divide a continuous trunk into annuli without separate exposed hard plates.

dorsal_brood_cell_patch.reason: Cavity depth is design-inferred. Host curvature fit and mature empty-cell landmarks need independent review.
dorsal_brood_cell_patch.discriminator: Individual recessed dorsal brood cells have soft raised rims lying in a continuous skin patch.

opposed_terminal_forceps.reason: Modeled one large-cercus adult male form with approximate rest and spread angles. Individual asymmetry and mechanical loads are unverified.
opposed_terminal_forceps.discriminator: Two curved cerci articulate from separate abdominal sockets and oppose each other across the midline with two movable arms.

overhanging_pronotal_crown.reason: The crown omits fine setae and infers thickness and exact branch separation from projected views. Function of the ornament is unresolved.
overhanging_pronotal_crown.discriminator: A rigid stalked crown rises from a small pronotal base and branches into free rounded terminals with large open spaces around the structure.

rigid_eyestalk_antenna_crown.reason: One side is authored. The posterior process depth, exact lens inset and antennal socket depth are inferred; individual eye facets and the antenna are outside the scope.
rigid_eyestalk_antenna_crown.discriminator: A continuous rigid head projection carries both the terminal compound eye and an adjacent antennal socket on its distal expansion.

stiff_to_membranous_forewing.reason: Thickness, curvature and raised-pose angle are authored. The apical venation is summarized by relief. Paired wing overlap, flex and specimen thickness are pending.
stiff_to_membranous_forewing.discriminator: A thickened basal forewing plate continues into a thin distal membrane with a visible transition and overlapping distal tips.

folding_pleonal_apron.reason: Ventral macro constrains the closed contour only. Pose, thickness, seat overlap and segment count across partly hidden proximal regions remain authored approximations.
folding_pleonal_apron.discriminator: A broad segmented pleon folds under the body, wrapping onto the sternum along a defined edge and opening on its posterior hinge.

pedal_swimming_wings.reason: Stroke and twist are independent static mesh controls. Root thickness and curvature are inferred. Matched local views from the same animal and a two-wing sweep remain pending.
pedal_swimming_wings.discriminator: Paired broad muscular lobes join the front of a shell-less body and flap through a short, fleshy root without a supporting ray skeleton.

dendritic_oral_collecting_tentacle.reason: Branch count and distribution are inferred from the silhouette of a whole crown. Folded fronds are supported by a pose control but not a recorded insertion sequence. Cilia and mucus are outside the geometry.
dendritic_oral_collecting_tentacle.discriminator: A tree-branched soft oral tentacle spreads distal collection branches then folds them together as the stem bends toward the mouth.

crinoid_pinnulate_arm.reason: The draft is an arm sector, with approximate size and groove width. Pinnule joints, individual tube feet and tissue-layer detail are simplified or omitted. The bend control approximates gross curl without skeletal joint constraints.
crinoid_pinnulate_arm.discriminator: A jointed axis carries two rows of separately seated side pinnules with surface collecting grooves leading to the arm groove.

ophiuroid_jointed_arm.reason: The sweep is a posed curve with independently seated hard surface islands. Dorsal and ventral armor outline, segment counts and spine axes remain simplified. The underlying articulating ossicles and oral tube feet are outside scope.
ophiuroid_jointed_arm.discriminator: An articulated side-bending arm carries repeating dorsal, ventral and lateral plates and separate lateral spine rows.

surface_float_sail.reason: The model describes only the exterior float. Colony appendages and internal structure are excluded. Crest lean is a signed geometric control. Fluid buoyancy and wind response are outside the static attachment model. Waterline and ventral contact fixture checks are open.
surface_float_sail.discriminator: A buoyant elongate sac carries a continuous raised sail seam along its top and supports dependent attachments along the underside.

hinged_gill_cover.reason: Medial face, hinge axis, thickness, and pose angles are inferred. A cover and abstract describe pumping without a quantified open pose.
hinged_gill_cover.discriminator: A movable, overlapping gill cover with a free rear edge is missing. Slits and exposed gill plumes represent different structures.

bill_edge_filter.reason: Coarse repeated units exaggerate relief and omit deep submarginal fields. Material, filtration and live gait are not simulated. Near-closed interference still needs checking.
bill_edge_filter.discriminator: Opposing comb-like lamellae integrated into the margins of a bill form a route between the jaw edges. Hanging racks of baleen and a hooked bill cover different forms.

annular_suction_mouth.reason: Tooth sectors and rim papillae are coarse approximations. The head-side depth is inferred and suction mechanics remain untested.
annular_suction_mouth.discriminator: A complete annular lip carries concentric keratin tooth fields around a central oral opening, with separate marginal fimbriae along the attachment rim.

crossed_bill_tips.reason: Crossing side is baked into the modeled individual. Tip overlap, lower hinge excursion, and hidden palate surface are estimates.
crossed_bill_tips.discriminator: Upper and lower bill tips curve laterally past one another and create a crossing tip contact that changes under off-axis jaw motion.

deployable_feather_crown.reason: Actual feather count, basal quill positions and fully folded profile are inferred from limited views. The deployment control morphs authored feathers and does not bind them to an animated rig.
deployable_feather_crown.discriminator: A row of independently seated long crown feathers changes from a nested, rear-folded stack to an elevated curved fan, preserving overlap around the skull.

rotating_ocular_turret.reason: Smooth geometry omits lid scales. Hidden internal globe is integrated as a visible corneal proxy. Pose sweep and mechanism are stylized.
rotating_ocular_turret.discriminator: A conical skin enclosure moves with most of the globe and leaves a small front aperture while the rounded base stays seated in the skull.

lateral_headfoil_sensor_seats.reason: Eye placement uses gross position only. Anterior channels are stylized and undercut seating was inferred. Reference is uncalibrated.
lateral_headfoil_sensor_seats.discriminator: A continuous flattened head crossbar blends into the cranium and houses eyes at both distal ends and olfactory openings along its leading edge.

immersed_lower_bill_blade.reason: Depth beneath water and jaw opening angles are illustrative. Foil thickness and bill attachment were estimated from the profile.
immersed_lower_bill_blade.discriminator: The laterally compressed lower blade extends well ahead of the upper bill and presents a long submerged cutting edge during a shallow open gape.

waterline_split_eye.reason: Neutral clay uses aperture and split relief in place of pigmentation and transparency. Optical performance is deliberately outside scope.
waterline_split_eye.discriminator: A single eye presents two separate pupil openings and air-facing and water-facing optical zones within one globe, registered to the habitual surface line.

nasal_tactile_rosette.reason: Exact active reach of each ray and the microscopic Eimer organs are outside this draft. Ray curvature in the contact pose is inferred.
nasal_tactile_rosette.discriminator: Individually rooted fleshy rays form an annulus around two nostrils, with shorter central ray pairs forming a distinct forward sampling region.

paired_dorsal_nasal_tubes.reason: The photograph does not resolve separate bore depth or distal opening shape. The partition, double passage interior and airway depth are inferred.
